implementation: ViPNet Common Crypto Core Library (User Space)
description: The ViPNet Common Crypto Core Library is a software library that provides cryptographic services to a number of ViPNet applications via an API. It is available in user space and kernel driver implementations on a wide range of operational systems. User space library and kernel library use the same base source code.
